public_rationale: The deadline is January 20, 2029. The reviewed benchmark milestone shows meaningful progress, but its evaluator explicitly does not claim AGI. It therefore fails the early-resolution rule. The forecast remains open, and the absence of a verified arrival by October 28, 2026 supplies no basis for declaring it supported.
limitations: No single benchmark establishes the broad AGI criterion.
Public evaluations cannot exclude undisclosed capabilities.

our_interpretation: This predicts no AGI arrival during the second presidential term, ending at noon Eastern time on January 20, 2029.
AGI means broadly general, human-level cognitive ability demonstrated across varied tasks and independently recognized beyond a developer's assertion.
And never was reinforces the forecast; it does not supply a separately measurable claim about what was historically possible.
The forecast horizon starts at publication, while any qualifying arrival earlier in the same term would also defeat the stated proposition.
criteria.support_condition: After the term ends, sufficiently comprehensive evidence establishes that no qualifying AGI system arrived during it.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A dated release or demonstration establishes a qualifying AGI arrival during the second term, before noon Eastern time on January 20, 2029.
